verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes an official MCP server (github.com/fivetran/fivetran-mcp) that lets an agent query sync status, manage connections, and perform read/write/delete operations, with configurable transport (stdio or hosted HTTP) — this is a first-party, documented MCP server enabling agent connectivity. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server's reliability beyond the vendor README.
